name: Glorifying God
overview: Scripture calls believers to actively glorify God through praise, exaltation, and thanksgiving, as seen in Psalms where the faithful are urged to magnify the Lord and exalt His name together. God promises deliverance in times of trouble, which results in His glorification by those He saves. Offering praise and ordering one's life rightly are presented as key ways to glorify God, reflecting a heart devoted to honoring His name above all the earth.
